bullets_filled.determinism_scenarios: 12/12 (100%), 2 independent instances, 3 runs each, byte-identical across separate OS processes

measurement_methodology.tick: median of a full CollapseSystem::step() over a stable solid SxSx10 wood box of exactly N bricks (clean stability solve, zero detachment); pieces/sec = placed / median-tick-seconds; 15 reps (7 at 100k)
measurement_methodology.collapse: remove entire foundation layer -> single cascade re-evaluation marks every upper brick unsupported (cascade_detect_ms), then settle under fixed-step gravity (collapse_settle_ms / collapse_ticks). Wide short box shape -> 3 ticks; not a tall free-fall
measurement_methodology.memory: phys_footprint delta (mach TASK_VM_INFO) across building the box; peak RSS via getrusage ru_maxrss (bytes on Darwin)
measurement_methodology.determinism: record event stream -> replay in fresh Sim; compare full per-event FNV-1a world-state hash sequence across 2 independent in-process Sim instances + a repeat run (3 total); also diffed final hashes across two separate process invocations (byte-identical)
measurement_methodology.correctness: hand-built structures classified by the solver vs expectations hand-derived from the documented integer model (Wood w2/S60, Stone w5/S200, ATTEN 4)

unmeasured.cross_machine_determinism: ___ (measured on one Apple M5 Pro / Apple Clang 21 only; integer-only design should port but cross-machine parity was not run)
unmeasured.tall_freefall_collapse_timing: ___ (perf-collapse scenario is a wide short box = 3 ticks; tall multi-tick cascades are covered functionally in CTest, not timed at 1k/10k/100k)

notes: All Must-have v1 delivered: integer voxel grid + placement rules (adjacency/no-overlap/bounds), anchor-reachability + integer load-propagation stability solver (Supported/Failing/Unsupported), fixed-timestep cascading collapse with gravity + re-anchoring, deterministic FNV-1a world-state hash, sized perf bench writing results/*.json. Engine-agnostic (no UE dependency) but Unreal-portable: POD Brick component data + World subsystem + tick(dt); mapping table in README. Determinism proven per-event across 2 instances/3 runs AND across separate OS processes. KEY DESIGN: all simulation state is integer/fixed-point (support/load/gravity), and the stability model is a fixpoint over fixed BFS distances so classification is order-independent; a self-rolled splitmix64 PRNG seeds scenarios (not <random>) for cross-toolchain reproducibility. One test-expectation bug found+fixed during bring-up (world hash includes the status field, so it legitimately changes after the first solve; test rewritten to assert physical no-move + idempotent re-settle). Out-of-scope (not built): Unreal integration/build, rendering, networking transport, PhysX, assets, snapshot/rollback, visualizer, save/load (all v2/should-have).
